```python
import sympy as sp

# Define the variable
x = sp.symbols('x')

# Define the equation
equation = sp.cbrt(x) + sp.cbrt(20 - x) - 2

# Solve the equation
solutions = sp.solve(equation, x)

# Filter the real solutions
real_solutions = [sol.evalf() for sol in solutions if sol.is_real]

# Sort the solutions to find the smaller value
smaller_solution = min(real_solutions)

# Express the smaller solution in the form p - sqrt(q)
p = sp.floor(smaller_solution)
q = sp.simplify(smaller_solution + p**2)

print(p + q)
```
